rationale: Genome-wide Brie knockout screens in primary OT-I/Cas9 CD8 T cells (Lin et al. 2024, Cancer Cell). The authors' MAGeCK comparisons, named in the GEO gene-summary files and Table S1, are intense stimulation vs the pre-reactivation sample (AICD_pre_vs_Act), acute stimulation vs pre-reactivation (pre_vs_Acute) and chronic tumour co-culture vs resting cells (Chronic_Rest_vs_Act); hits are guides enriched after stimulation. GEO deposits the count tables only as additional sample files: one with Intense, Acute, preA-Bulk and T0 in which the two replicate libraries per condition were already summed by the authors ('sum_rep'), and one with Chronic and Resting (one library each). prepare.R merges them by sgRNA. Each comparison is one library against one, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path and calls are screening-level. 1,000 non-targeting guides serve as controls; library totals are used.
